rows.commentary: 0.1: Kulwant Khejroliya starts the over horribly as Habibur Rahman Sohan swats the delivery over backward square leg for a maximum.
0.2: Kulwant Khejroliya misses his length again and Habibur Rahman Sohan punishes it, sending the ball soaring over long-off for another six.
0.3: Kulwant Khejroliya offers width and Habibur Rahman Sohan carves it square of the wicket to pick up a boundary.
0.4: Kulwant Khejroliya pulls back his length slightly, allowing Habibur Rahman Sohan to simply push it down to long-off for a single.
0.5: Kulwant Khejroliya strays too full to the new batter, and Sabbir Rahman launches it high over deep mid-wicket for a massive six.
0.6: Kulwant Khejroliya recovers slightly with a straight delivery, nudged down the ground by Sabbir Rahman for a single.
Habibur Rahman Sohan is on fire, smashing boundaries off three consecutive deliveries to race to 17 runs!
1.1: Krunal Pandya is welcomed into the attack as Sabbir Rahman sweeps it fiercely away to fine leg for a maximum.
3.4: Ahrar Amin strikes as Rahul Tripathi departs for 32 after seeing his timber disturbed by a sharp delivery.
3.5: Nitish Rana rotates the strike neatly, guiding Ahrar Amin towards sweeper cover for a single.
3.6: Shashank Singh launches Ahrar Amin towering over long-off for a maximum.
4.1: Nitish Rana pushes Mrittunjoy Chowdhury down to long-on to collect a comfortable single.
4.2: Dot ball from Mrittunjoy Chowdhury to Shashank Singh.
4.3: Shashank Singh deflects Mrittunjoy Chowdhury deftly away to the fine leg boundary for four.
4.4: Shashank Singh targets long-on against Mrittunjoy Chowdhury, clearing the ropes with ease for six.
4.5: Mrittunjoy Chowdhury is sent sailing straight down the ground for another maximum by Shashank Singh.
4.6: Mrittunjoy Chowdhury drops it short, and Rahul Tewatia pushes it firmly down to long-off for a single.
5.1: Rahul Tewatia greets Habibur Rahman Sohan by dispatching him over long-off for a massive six.
5.2: Rahul Tewatia finds the gap behind square, working Habibur Rahman Sohan to the backward square leg boundary for four.
5.3: Habibur Rahman Sohan strays again as Rahul Tewatia guides it neatly to fine leg for four more runs.
5.4: Rahul Tewatia works Habibur Rahman Sohan down towards deep backward point to pick up a single.
5.5: Habibur Rahman Sohan delivers to Nitish Rana, who launches it powerfully square of the wicket for a maximum.
5.6: Habibur Rahman Sohan charges in again, and Nitish Rana works it away toward square leg to comfortably pick up a brace.
Rahul Tewatia is putting on a show, smashing boundaries off his last three deliveries to electrify the crowd!
